verdict.rationale: BigQuery's first-party docs describe in-product AI features that cover this story: Data insights automatically generates queries from table metadata to uncover patterns and run statistical analysis. Gemini in BigQuery adds conversational analytics, which lets users ask natural-language questions about their data (recently extended to market basket analysis), plus data canvas for exploration and visualization and SQL/Python code generation and suggestions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights are useful in practice, and detail on how deep the generated suggestions go.
